get.description: Retrieve all charge stations. Option to filter based on specific Location ID.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Retrieve Charge Stations updates after this date. Status updates of EVSEs do count as an update. If this is used to populate an external database, then calls should be made at a maximum of 1 per hour.

parameters.name: exclude_evses_modified
parameters.description: When set to true the date_from and date_to parameters will exclude changes on the Evse level. Only changes for Charge Station will be taken into account.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for paging. Offset any number of entities

post.description: Create a Charge Stations. Must have either full EVSE object or use HardwareTemplateID

get.description:
Get a Charge Station by ID. Data is real time.
Not intended to pull all Charge Stations by ID every couple of minutes. Please use the Get all Charge Stations endpoint.

patch.description: Patch a single or few fields for a charge station.

parameters.name: cpoId
parameters.description: allows to query on a specific sub-CPO

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Retrieve Locations updates after this date. Status updates of EVSEs don't count as an update.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The 3 character country code of the location

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: This is used to search by geolocation. The latitude provided is the center of the search. Longitude must be supplied if latitude is provided.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: This is used to search by geolocation. The longitude provided is the center of the search. latitude must be supplied if longitude is provided.

parameters.name: exclude_evses_modified
parameters.description: When set to true the date_from and date_to parameters will exclude changes on the Evse level. Only changes for Location will be taken into account.

parameters.name: distanceinmeters
parameters.description: This is used to search by geolocation. It is the search radius, minimum/default of 100 metres. maximum 1000 metres. Only used when latitude and longitude are supplied

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for paging. Offset any number of entities

get.description: Get a Location by ID. Real time.

parameters.name: excludeEvses
parameters.description: Exclude the Evse Object. Default is false

post.summary: Batch update multiple configurations of multiple charge stations
post.description: This API allows you to batch update multiple configurations of multiple charge stations.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description (friendly name) of the batch update

requestBody.description: The input is a ; delimited CSV file with the following columns: (ChargeStationId; Key; Value; ResetOnAccepted (OnIdle, Immediate or empty); Retries (number of retries (0 - 5)); Delay (number of seconds between each try (0 - 60))

get.summary: Get the history of batch config updates.
get.description: This API allows you to get a history of batch config updates.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Will return only Batch Change Configuration created since this date.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Will return only Batch Change Configuration created up to this date.

get.summary: Get the report data for a batch config update
get.description: This API allows you to retrieve the report for a batch config update operation.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: The ReportId that you get in the response before.

get.summary: Get the source input for a batch config
get.description: This API allows you to retrieve the source input file for a batch config update operation.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: The ReportId that you get in the response before.

200.description: The output will be a csv file with the following columns: (ChargeStationId, Key, Value, ResetOnAccepted, Retries)

get.summary: Get Batch Report CSV Output File
get.description: This API allows you to retrieve the report for a batch config update operation.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: The ReportId that you get in the response before.

200.description: The output will be a csv file with the following columns: (ChargeStationId, Key, Value, ResetOnAccepted, Retries, Delay, Status, Remarks)

post.summary: Get Configuration Item for Multiple Charge Stations
post.description: This API allows you to retrieve the value of a configuration item for multiple charge stations.

200.description: A csv file containing following columns: (ChargeStationId, Value)

get.description: This API allows you to retrieve all configuration values for a particular charge station.

parameters.name: chargeStationId
parameters.description: The ChargeStationId to retrive configuration values for it.

200.description: The output will be a csv file with the following columns: (ChargeStationId, Key, Value)

get.description: This API allows you to retrieve the public root certificate of GreenFlux.

200.description: The output will be a string of root certificate

value.description: For customer EMSP object, you need to indicate its external ID, for token EMSP object, you need to indicate the Auth ID.

charge_station_template_id.description: Hardware template id used when creating or updating a CS. Not returned in a GET call.

created_by.description: Username who created the object. Can be supplied during creation or updating, otherwise 'Not Provided' as default. If edited via the EvPortal, this will be propulatd from there.

modified_by.description: Username of last modification of the object. Can be supplied during creation or updating, otherwise 'Not Provided' as default. If edited via the EvPortal, this will be propulatd from there.

created.description: date when the Location was created

modified.description: date when the Location was last modified

heartbeat_interval.description: the heartbeat interval set for this charge station (read-only)

charge_point_vendor.description: the charge point vendor or manufacturer (read-only)

charge_point_serial_number.description: serial number of the charge station (read-only)

GcpiChargeStationDeployState.description: The deployment state of the Charge Station. Only in Production are Locations and CDRs shared externally.

GcpiChargeStationTemplate.description: The Hardware template used for this Charge Station. EVSEs can still be updated independently afterwards.

GcpiChargingSpeed.description: This field is auto-generated based on the max-power set at the Connector level. Slow - all connectors are AC; Fast means DC between 50-100kW; Rapid is above 101kW; Mix AC_DC and Mix_DC are a combination of the previous options.

id.description: Identifier of the connector within the EVSE. Two connectors may have the same id as long as they do not belong to the same EVSE object

power_type.description: the power type of the charge station

voltage.description: Voltage of the connector (line to neutral for AC_3_PHASE), in volt

amperage.description: Maximum amperage of the connector, in ampere [A].

max_electric_power.description: Maximum electric power that can be delivered by this connector, in watt [W]. When the maximum electric power is lower than the calculated value from voltage and amperage, this value should be set. OCPI addendum.

tariff_id.description: Identifier of the current charging tariff structure. For a "Free of Charge" tariff this field should be set, and point to a defined "Free of Charge" tariff.

terms_and_conditions.description: URL to the operator’s terms and conditions.

last_updated.description: Timestamp when this Connectors was last updated (or created).

GcpiCustomGroup.description: Custom Groups the Location belongs to. Only applicable for Charge Stations on GreenFlux Platform.

energy_mix_profile_id.description: the energy mix profile Id used

energy_sources.description: Key-value pairs (enum + percentage) of energy sources of this location’s tariff

environ_impact.description: Key-value pairs (enum + percentage) of nuclear waste and CO2 exhaust of this location’s tariff.

supplier_name.description: Name of the energy supplier, delivering the energy for this location or tariff

energy_product_name.description: Name of the energy suppliers product/tariff plan used at this location

energy_mix_profile_id.description: the energy mix profile Id used

uid.description: Uniquely identifies the EVSE within the CPOs platform.  This is the ‘technical’ identification of the EVSE, sometimes referred to as Node ID

evse_id.description: Unique EVSE where MeterValue has been generated from

capabilities.description: List of functionalities that the EVSE is capable of.

floor_level.description: Level on which the charging station is located (in garage buildings) in the locally displayed numbering scheme

physical_reference.description: A number/string printed on the outside of the EVSE for visual identification.

directions.description: Multi-language human-readable directions when more detailed information on how to reach the EVSE from the Location is required. Typically not used for small Locations

last_updated.description: Timestamp when this EVSE or one of its Connectors was last updated (or created)

evse_sequence_number.description: The sequence number of the EVSE

GcpiEvse.description: List of EVSEs that belong to this Location

GcpiEvseStatus.description: The possible states a the Charge Station as a whole or each Connector can return based on OCPI.

GcpiExceptionalPeriod.description: Exceptions for specified calendar dates, time-range based

twentyfourseven.description: auto-created field. If opening hours are not 24-7 then it is 'false'

publish.description: Defines if a Location may be published on a website or app etc.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the country of this location.

facilities.description: Optional list of facilities this charge location directly belongs to.

time_zone.description: One of IANA tzdata’s TZ-values representing the time zone of the location

charging_when_closed.description: Indicates if the EVSEs are still charging outside the opening hours of the location.

remarks.description: General notes and remarks for the Location

wallet_id.description: the walled ID used for this charge station
